name: post-engineer
description: Post Engineer monorepo: Next.js web + scheduling and publishing engine + MCP server

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-contracts.mjs && pnpm exec nx build web
scripts.lint: node .github/scripts/comments/check.mjs && pnpm exec nx run-many -t lint
scripts.lint:dead-code: knip --no-progress && node .github/scripts/dead-code/contracts.mjs && (cd apps/engine && uv run vulture)
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec nx run web:lint:fix && pnpm exec nx run-many -t lint typecheck
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/sync-contracts.mjs && pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck
